en.headline: Ligent Technologies opens 11 per cent above offer price
en.dek: The optical-module maker, listed as 09856, began trading at HK$36.60 against a HK$32.96 issue price after a 35-times subscribed public offer.
body: Shares in Ligent Technologies, known in Chinese as Nazhen Technology and listed under stock code 09856, opened at HK$36.60 when they began trading on the Hong Kong stock exchange on Tuesday morning, about 11 per cent above the final offer price of HK$32.96.

The company supplies optical modules and related photonic products used in data centres and telecom networks. It said that in 2025 it accounted for 4 per cent of global optical-module revenue among specialist makers. The listing raised about HK$5.67 billion. Citigroup and CITIC Securities were joint sponsors.
The Hong Kong public offer was about 35 times subscribed. Board lots are 100 shares. Grey-market quotes on Monday closed near HK$36, above the issue price.
Trading opened at 9am. Early deals after the open held a single-digit to low-double-digit premium to the offer price.

zh.headline: 納真科技首掛高開一成報36.6元
zh.dek: 光模塊供應商股份代號09856，公開發售超購約35倍，開市較招股僳32.96元高出約11%。
body: 納真科技（股份代號09856）周二早上在港交所掛牌，開市報36.6元，較最終發售僳32.96元高出約11%。
公司主要供應應用於數據中心及電訊網絡的光模塊及相關光通信產品。公司表示，2025年按全球專業光模塊廠商收入計，佔有4%市場份額。是次上市集資約56.7億元，聯席保薦人為花旗及中信証券。
香港公開發售超額認購約35倍，每手100股。周一暗盤報僸接近36元，高於發行僳。
股份上午9時開始買賣，開市後早段維持高於招股僳的升幅。
